svg.title: NET-08 — Initial direct connection failure
svg.desc: 1920 by 1080 client with the centered 850 by 700 logical menu canvas at 135 percent. The existing direct Host unreachable variant separates confirmed reason, retained locally entered endpoint, instruction and recovery actions. Retry is focused and eligible in this example. Current password, security, browser-origin, startup and terminal variants retain their own fixed copy and recovery eligibility without new geometry.

g.text: Check that the host session is running and the endpoint is correct.
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Existing initial Direct failure example, not a new screenshot scenario. Background is the same session still/scrim.
Reason, endpoint and instruction stay separate. Long reasons wrap/scroll in the body; heading and enabled recovery actions stay visible.
Actions wrap in reading order before captions clip. Disabled Retry has a readable flat frame and its persistent reason where applicable.
Password rejection, secure-channel failure and browser recovery follow current NET-08 authority; never add certificate prompts or secret text.
Host-service/terminal variants omit endpoint context and retain exact confirmed copy and recovery eligibility. No speculative cause or bypass.
